Callout.Name: Psychiatric Emergency
Callout.Message: Person in acute distress, family asking for help.
Callout.Advisory: No weapon, no aggression, family on scene.

Script.Line: I do not need an ambulance. I am not the one who called.
My brother is inside and he has not come out of that room in three days.
He is not a danger to anybody. He is frightened, that is all.

Lines.Approach: Nobody has been hurt and nobody is threatening anybody. He is frightened and so is his family.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
